rows.note: This is the all-purpose choice when emphasizing that something makes a room, desk, or area messy.

example.english: Your junk is enough to clutter the room.
example.traditional: 你啲雜物搞到間房亂晒喇。
example.jyutping: nei5 di1 zaap6 mat6 gaau2 dou3 gaan3 fong2 lyun6 saai3 laa3

rows.note: Use this when clutter consists of piles or objects physically filling a space.

example.english: Piles of papers clutter the desk, leaving no room for even a glass of water.
example.traditional: 張枱堆滿晒文件，連杯水都冇位擺。
example.jyutping: zoeng1 toi2 deoi1 mun5 saai3 man4 gin2 lin4 bui1 seoi2 dou1 mou5 wai6 baai2

rows.note: This is the all-purpose choice for a confused, disordered mess of things.

example.english: As soon as I walked in, I saw clutter all over the room.
example.traditional: 我一入門口就見到成間房一團亂。
example.jyutping: ngo5 jat1 jap6 mun4 hau2 zau6 gin3 dou2 sing4 gaan1 fong4 jat1 tyun4 lyun6

rows.jyutping: lyun6 cat1 baat3 zou1 ge3 je5
rows.note: Use this when you want to emphasize the jumble of miscellaneous things themselves.

example.english: Please stop bringing home all that clutter.
example.traditional: 你唔好再買啲亂七八糟嘅嘢返嚟喇。
example.jyutping: nei5 m4 hou2 zoi3 maai5 di1 lyun6 cat1 baat3 zou1 ge3 je5 faan1 lai4 laa3

rows.note: Use this for miscellaneous objects cluttering a room or space, especially when the objects rather than the disorder are the focus.

example.english: This drawer is full of clutter, and I can't even find a box cutter.
example.traditional: 呢個櫃桶塞滿咗雜物，連張鎅刀都搵唔到。
example.jyutping: ni1 go3 gwai6 tung2 sak1 mun5 zo2 zaap6 mat6 lin4 zoeng1 gaai3 dou1 dou1 wan2 m4 dou3
